about: Ids a build may not have, with the reason a load gives when a file names one (notes/2026-10-06-state-files.md §9, §10.3): `gpl`, a module built in only with the GPL switch on (FM1_GPL_MODS; CLAUDE.md, "The GPL switch"); `planned`, an engine or kind not built yet; `retired`, one taken out, with the version that did it in `since`. An id never leaves this list, and a retired one is never given out again. The metadata export (fm1-render --meta) lists the ones the build lacks. tools/gen_known.py turns this file and engines/aliases.json into engines/state/fm1_known.c; tests/test_engine_names.py checks the two agree. The GPL ids are the fm1-x0x study's names (notes/2026-10-06-fm1-x0x.md §6.1; approved by the owner on 2026-10-06): each `gpl` id is a module the build with the switch on has; `chop`, Felucca's SLICE, is `planned` until a build has it. A build's module list (FM1_MODULES) may leave out any module besides: the export gives those the reason `list` (engines/modules/catalogue.mk).
